scope: One labeled final payment per authored story; synthetic coverage, not real fraud accuracy

cases.story: An attacker uses several devices for rapid EUR 900 attempts. Four are declined before two are approved by the payment provider.
cases.label: SUSPICIOUS

cases.story: An attacker makes four declined EUR 1 attempts and then a EUR 900 payment from the same device.
cases.label: SUSPICIOUS

cases.story: A customer pays for coffee, groceries and public transport using the same phone.
cases.label: LEGITIMATE

cases.story: A customer buys an appliance for EUR 1,100 using a phone already observed during this session.
cases.label: LEGITIMATE

cases.story: A customer retries a EUR 20 purchase after one decline. Each authorization attempt has a distinct transaction ID.
cases.label: LEGITIMATE

cases.story: An attacker spends EUR 1,100 three times from three devices within 80 seconds.
cases.label: SUSPICIOUS

cases.story: A customer replaces their phone and buys a EUR 900 laptop. The new device is legitimate, but the engine cannot know that.
cases.label: LEGITIMATE

cases.story: An attacker sends six EUR 5 payments within 75 seconds. Frequency alone scores below the review threshold.
cases.label: SUSPICIOUS

cases.story: An attacker with access to the known phone makes one ordinary EUR 70 purchase. The available fields look like legitimate activity.
cases.label: SUSPICIOUS
